description: Restores an Open Design design from a synced Claude artifact (one published with publish_open_design_artifact, provider claude-artifact and sync: true) into this workspace, so it can be edited and republished here. Use when the user gives a Claude artifact link to pick a design back up on another device or in a new session. First read the artifact with your Artifact tool, which saves the page to a file; pass that file's path (in Claude Desktop with a folder, a path in the connected folder) and the artifact link. It writes the design's files under the output directory, all or nothing, refuses paths that leave it, and doesn't overwrite local files that differ unless overwrite is true. It records the link, so the next preview publish updates the same artifact. Never makes a network request.

overwrite.description: Replace local files whose content differs from the artifact's. Default false: the restore then writes nothing and lists them. Only after the user chooses the artifact's version.

pagePath.description: Path of the page your Artifact tool saved when reading the artifact: absolute, or relative to the workspace.

name: restore_open_design_artifact
